dedupe_keys.name: human displacements fatalities and economic damages linked to remotely observed floods

description: Human displacements, fatalities, and economic damages linked to remotely observed floods is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Benedikt Mester et al. We present a new open source dataset FLODIS that links estimates of flood-induced human displacements, fatalities, and economic damages to flooded areas observed through remote sensing. Coverage: not stated; published in 2023. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
